name.description: Resource name, used as JSON-LD @type, in /contexts/<name> and in tool names.
name.x-hint: PascalCase letters and digits, singular, e.g. "Book" or "BookReview".

path.description: Collection path. Items are served at <path>/<identifier>. Required unless the definition declares operations.
path.x-hint: Lowercase, starts with a slash, no trailing slash, e.g. "/books" or "/book-reviews".

table.description: Table (or schema.table) backing the resource. Alone, reads the declared properties from it. With query, it is metadata only: the query reads, while ctx.resource() helpers, relations and generated writes use the table.
table.x-hint: A table name such as "book" or "public.book".

query.description: Script building the rows, in the definitions directory: TypeScript named <name>.query.ts, or Starlark (Python syntax) named <name>.star or <name>.py. Each property must be a column returned by the query. May be combined with table (the table then only describes the resource).
query.x-hint: A file name in the same directory, no directory part: "book.query.ts" (TypeScript) or "book.star" / "book.py" (Starlark).

command.description: Script performing writes, in the definitions directory: TypeScript named <name>.command.ts, or Starlark named <name>.star / <name>.py. It defines create, update and/or remove functions. Replaces the generated INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE of a table resource; required to make a query resource writable.
command.x-hint: A file name in the same directory, no directory part: "book.command.ts" (TypeScript) or "book_command.star" (Starlark).

input.description: Input DTO: the request body accepted by writes (POST/PUT/PATCH), validated before the command runs. Keys are body keys. Default for table resources: the properties that are not readOnly.
input.x-hint: Input field names use letters, digits and underscores.

relations.description: Links to other resources, used by ctx.resource() helpers (join, relation) and to name nested columns. To-one: {"resource": "Author", "column": "author_id"} (the column of this table holding the related identifier). To-many: {"resource": "Book", "foreignKey": "author_id", "many": true} (the column of the related table pointing back here).
relations.x-hint: Relation names use letters, digits and underscores, usually the property they fill ("author", "books").

parameters.description: HTTP query and header parameters that change the response: built-in filters, ordering, pagination, or a handler script. Parsed and validated (type, min, max, enum, required) before anything runs; a failure answers 400, or the declared status. Undeclared query parameters are ignored.
parameters.x-hint: The key is the query parameter name (order filter: the prefix of order[<property>]) or the header name.

order.description: Default collection order when no order parameter is sent, e.g. {"createdAt": "desc"}. Keys are properties, in priority order; the identifier is always added last as a tiebreak.
order.x-hint: An object of property name to "asc" or "desc".

envelope.description: Wrap JSON (format json) collections in an object instead of a bare array. Each key names the output field of that value; omitted keys are not output. Overrides the Caddyfile envelope.

errors.description: Error response shape: "problem" (application/problem+json, default) or an object mapping output fields to error fields, e.g. {"error": "message"}. Overrides the Caddyfile errors option. Definition errors are always problem+json.
errors.x-hint: "problem", or an object such as {"error": "message"} whose values are among message, code, status, pointer, hint, resource.

errorDetails.description: With an errors object shape: true (default) also outputs code, hint, pointer and errors (several input errors) as extra keys; false outputs only the declared keys. Overrides the Caddyfile error_details option.

unknownInput.description: What writes do with body keys that are not in input: reject (422 unknown_property, default) or ignore.

formats.description: Output formats this resource accepts in Accept / ?format= / path suffix. Default: all of jsonld, json, csv.

operations.description: Dedicated endpoints replacing the default CRUD operations. Each has its own method, path, pinned format and optionally its own query/command; properties describe their rows.

allow.description: Capabilities granted to the query and command scripts.

fetch.description: Hosts ctx.fetch may call, as host or host:port ("api.example.com", "127.0.0.1:9000").
fetch.x-hint: A host name, optionally with :port, without scheme or path.

env.x-hint: An environment variable name such as API_TOKEN.

itemsPerPage.description: Default page size of collections (the itemsPerPage pagination parameter lets clients change it).

properties.description: Exposed fields, in output order. Keys are both the JSON field names and the column names.
properties.x-hint: Property names use letters, digits and underscores and must equal a column name.

type.description: JSON output type. date is YYYY-MM-DD, datetime an RFC 3339 string in UTC. object needs properties, array needs items.
type.x-hint: One of: string, integer, number, boolean, date, datetime, object, array.

identifier.description: Exactly one property must be the identifier (type integer or string). It builds the item IRI <path>/<value> and orders collections.

filterable.description: Allow exact-match filtering with ?<property>=<value> on the collection.

required.description: Must be present in the body of POST and PUT.

readOnly.description: Output only: rejected in request bodies (computed or joined columns).

column.description: Column of table holding this property, when it differs from the property name (price_cents for priceCents). Used by table reads, generated writes and ctx.resource() helpers.
column.x-hint: A column name of the table.

computed.description: Not a column of table: the query computes it. ctx.resource().columns() skips it.

properties.description: Nested properties of an object property, in output order. Filled from a json column of the same name, or from columns named <property>_<nested>.

items.description: Shape of the elements of an array property (filled from a json column, e.g. json_agg).

method.x-hint: One of: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE (upper case), or a non-empty array of distinct methods served by one handler, e.g. ["GET", "POST"].

path.x-hint: Lowercase, starts with a slash, no trailing slash, e.g. "/business/export"; an item operation holds /{<identifier>} once, at the end or before more segments, e.g. "/authors/{id}" or "/purchases/{id}/refund".

format.description: Pinned output format: Accept is ignored. Default jsonld.

query.description: Query script of this operation (GET). Defaults to the definition's query or table.
query.x-hint: A file name in the same directory, no directory part: "book.query.ts" (TypeScript) or "book.star" / "book.py" (Starlark).

command.description: Command script of this operation (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE); the function called is create (POST), update (PUT/PATCH) or remove (DELETE). Defaults to the definition's command.
command.x-hint: A file name in the same directory, no directory part: "book.command.ts" (TypeScript) or "book_command.star" (Starlark).

input.description: Input DTO of this operation; defaults to the definition's input. An empty object ({}) means the operation takes no body: one sent is ignored.
input.x-hint: Input field names use letters, digits and underscores.

output.description: Properties output by this operation, in order, when it differs from the resource's properties (list vs item).

parameters.description: Parameters of this operation, added to (and overriding by name) the definition's.

order.description: Default collection order when no order parameter is sent, e.g. {"createdAt": "desc"}. Keys are properties, in priority order; the identifier is always added last as a tiebreak.
order.x-hint: An object of property name to "asc" or "desc".

type.x-hint: One of: string, integer, number, boolean, date, datetime, object, array.

required.description: Must be present in the body of POST and PUT.

column.description: Column written by generated INSERT/UPDATE; defaults to the column of the property of the same name, else the input name.

properties.description: Fields of an object input, validated recursively (errors point at /field/nested).

items.description: Shape of the elements of an array input (errors point at /field/<index>/...).

resource.description: Name of the related resource; it must declare table.
resource.x-hint: The name of another definition, e.g. "Author".

column.description: To-one: column of this resource's table holding the related identifier.

foreignKey.description: To-many: column of the related table holding this resource's identifier.

many.description: true for a to-many relation (needs foreignKey).

in.description: Where the value is read: query string or request header.

type.description: Type the value is parsed to. Default: the type of the filtered property, else string.
type.x-hint: One of: string, integer, number, boolean, date, datetime.

required.description: Missing value answers the error status.

status.description: HTTP status of a missing or invalid value (and default status of ctx.reject in the handler). Default 400. Parameters with a status are checked first.

filter.description: Built-in filter applied to collection reads.
filter.x-hint: One of: exact, partial, ipartial, range, date, boolean, order.

property.description: Property filtered, default the parameter name; may follow an object property (author.name).
property.x-hint: A property name, or <objectProperty>.<nested> such as author.name.

properties.description: order filter: the properties a client may sort on.

pagination.description: Makes this parameter the page number or the client-chosen page size.

handler.description: Script called with (value, ctx) when the value is present: returns a SQL condition, null, or calls ctx.reject; may ctx.set(name, value) for the query.
handler.x-hint: A file name in the same directory: "in_stock.handler.ts" or "in_stock.star".
